LR.reference: sklearn.calibration.CalibratedClassifierCV(FrozenEstimator(pipeline), method='sigmoid') fitted on T_cal; public API only
LR.explanation: NOT identical within 1e-6 in logit (max 2.09e-06; max probability difference 1.15e-07). Both minimize the same strictly convex objective; the own fit has gradient 3.3e-11 and the public fit 1.2e-05, with objective difference -5.8e-13. The difference is the public optimizer stopping earlier (L-BFGS-B, gtol 1e-6, after scikit-learn rescales scores with max |s| >= 30), not a different calibrator. The own fit is used.

HGB.reference: sklearn.calibration.CalibratedClassifierCV(FrozenEstimator(pipeline), method='sigmoid') fitted on T_cal; public API only
HGB.explanation: identical within 1e-6 in logit: both minimize the same strictly convex Platt objective (own: damped Newton, Lin, Lin and Weng 2007; scikit-learn: L-BFGS-B, gtol 1e-6)

gate.rule: held-out split-stability frequency >= 0.9 and median held-out delta AP > 0

limitations: held-out halves hold few frauds, so held-out AP is very noisy

the halves are not independent; the buffer only limits short-range dependence
E2 is a decision heuristic; it indicates selection optimism but neither removes nor estimates it without bias
